_comment.num_inference_steps: Original Fast-WAM inference step count S.
_comment.picard_tol: Stride tolerance tau of Eq. 4/5 (threshold tau^2 * sigma^2).
_comment.stride_residual: 'prefix' evaluates the stride test of Eq. 4 on the executed prefix 1:R_n (paper default); 'full' uses the whole chunk 1:H (ablation, Tab. 5).
_comment.r_max: Fixed R_max = the original Fast-WAM execution length R for LIBERO.
_comment.dynamic_replan_enabled: Residual-guided commitment (paper Sec. 3.4) is disabled on LIBERO: R_max <= R_min = ceil(H/2) = 16, so R stays fixed.
_comment.dynamic_replan_log_mean: mu of the log-normal commitment map R_{n+1} = round(R_max - (R_max - R_min) * Phi((log u_n - mu) / varsigma)); unused here.
_comment.dynamic_replan_log_std: varsigma of the same map; unused here.
